SCIENCE ADVENTURE 25 · CLASS 31

Fox’s Compass Adventure

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Directions

North, east, south, west — learn which way each arrow points on Fox’s compass.

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · DIRECTIONS

Fox’s Compass Adventure

A compass always shows the way! The arrow pointing UP is NORTH, DOWN is SOUTH, RIGHT is EAST, and LEFT is WEST. Tap the direction I ask for!

Which arrow points UP? Tap the word for that direction!

Which arrow points DOWN? Tap the word for that direction!

Which arrow points RIGHT? Tap the word for that direction!

Which arrow points LEFT? Tap the word for that direction!

Navigator Fox!

North up, south down, east right, west left — you know your way around the world!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Start with the body trick: face the sunrise (east), and north is on your left. Then hide a toy and navigate with “two steps north, one step east!”

Illustration note: Loaded by content: the file named monkeys-sound-lab actually carries this Fox’s Compass Adventure artwork (the R2 export shifted files 20–30 by one slot).

Prefer paper? The Fox’s Compass Adventure worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
